source.author: verg
source.text: Haec germanus Eryx quondam tuus arma gerebat; sanguine cernis adhuc sparsoque infecta cerebro; his magnum Alciden contra stetit; his ego suetus, dum melior vires sanguis dabat, aemula necdum temporibus geminis canebat sparsa senectus.
source.text_original: Haec germanus Eryx quondam tuus arma gerebat; — / sanguine cernis adhuc sparsoque infecta cerebro; — / his magnum Alciden contra stetit; his ego suetus, / dum melior vires sanguis dabat, aemula necdum / temporibus geminis canebat sparsa senectus.
source.text_english: These weapons your brother Eryx once wielded; you see them still stained with blood and smeared with scattered brains. With these weapons he stood against great Alcides. With these I too was accustomed, while better blood still gave me strength; my rival, not yet, with double temples, had scattered old age made gray.

reuse.text_english: such men, such men am I wont to lead and follow.
